Clinical_Note: Patient presented with polydipsia, polyuria, and blurred vision for 3 weeks. Fasting blood sugar level is 210 mg/dL. Diagnosed with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Essential Hypertension. Initiated on Metformin 500 mg twice daily and Lisinopril 10 mg once daily for 90 days. Patient reports mild Lisinopril-induced dry cough over the last 4 days.
Symptoms: polydipsia; polyuria; blurred vision; dry cough

Clinical_Note: Patient reports acute retrosternal chest pain radiating to left shoulder and severe shortness of breath starting 2 hours prior to admission. ECG reveals ST elevation in leads V1-V4. Clinical evaluation confirms Acute Myocardial Infarction and Coronary Artery Disease. Administered Aspirin 325 mg immediately, Clopidogrel 75 mg once daily, and Atorvastatin 80 mg bedtime for 6 months. No adverse drug reactions reported.
Disease: Acute Myocardial Infarction; Coronary Artery Disease
Symptoms: retrosternal chest pain; shortness of breath; left shoulder pain

Clinical_Note: 62-year-old female complaining of recurrent wheezing, persistent nocturnal cough, and shortness of breath exacerbated by cold air over the past 2 months. Spirometry confirms Bronchial Asthma. Prescribed Albuterol 90 mcg 2 puffs as needed for acute symptoms and Fluticasone 110 mcg 2 puffs twice daily for 30 days. Patient developed oral candidiasis secondary to Fluticasone inhaler use after 10 days of treatment.
Symptoms: recurrent wheezing; persistent nocturnal cough; shortness of breath; oral thrush
Frequency: 2 puffs as needed; 2 puffs twice daily

Clinical_Note: 71-year-old male with long-standing history of Type 2 Diabetes and Hypertension presenting with bilateral lower extremity edema, fatigue, and decreased urine output over 1 month. Laboratory findings show eGFR 28 mL/min and serum creatinine 2.4 mg/dL indicating Stage 4 Chronic Kidney Disease. Prescribed Furosemide 40 mg once daily in morning and Losartan 50 mg once daily for 60 days. Patient noted mild orthostatic dizziness post Furosemide dose.
Disease: Stage 4 Chronic Kidney Disease; Type 2 Diabetes; Hypertension
Symptoms: bilateral lower extremity edema; fatigue; decreased urine output; orthostatic dizziness
Frequency: once daily in morning; once daily

Clinical_Note: 29-year-old female presents with throbbing unilateral right-sided headache, photophobia, phonophobia, and visual aura lasting 12 hours. Patient has experienced 4 similar episodes in the last month. Diagnosed with Migraine with Aura. Commenced Sumatriptan 50 mg as needed at onset and Topiramate 25 mg twice daily for prophylaxis over 90 days. Reports mild paresthesia in extremities associated with Topiramate after 1 week.
Symptoms: throbbing unilateral headache; photophobia; phonophobia; visual aura; paresthesia
Temporal_Information: lasting 12 hours; last month; after 1 week

Clinical_Note: 45-year-old male presenting with high-grade fever (102.4 F), productive cough with rust-colored sputum, and pleuritic chest pain for 4 days. Chest X-ray demonstrates right lower lobe consolidation consistent with Community-Acquired Pneumonia. Initiated on Amoxicillin-Clavulanate 875/125 mg twice daily for 10 days and Paracetamol 650 mg every 6 hours as needed for fever. Developed Amoxicillin-induced maculopapular skin rash on day 3.
Symptoms: high-grade fever; productive cough; rust-colored sputum; pleuritic chest pain; skin rash
Frequency: twice daily; every 6 hours as needed; once daily

Clinical_Note: 67-year-old female presenting with severe morning stiffness (>1 hour), symmetrical joint swelling, and pain in bilateral metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints for 6 months. Elevated RF and anti-CCP titers confirm Rheumatoid Arthritis. Prescribed Methotrexate 15 mg once weekly, Folic Acid 5 mg once weekly, and Prednisone 5 mg once daily for 30 days. Patient reports Methotrexate-induced nausea 24 hours after dose.
Symptoms: morning stiffness; symmetrical joint swelling; MCP joint pain; nausea
Frequency: once weekly; once weekly; once daily

Clinical_Note: 52-year-old male with a 6-month history of burning epigastric pain, nocturnal acid regurgitation, and dysphagia. Endoscopy demonstrates Los Angeles Grade B Esophagitis confirming Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD). Prescribed Omeprazole 40 mg once daily before breakfast for 8 weeks and Famotidine 20 mg at bedtime. Patient reports complete resolution of heartburn symptoms. No adverse drug reactions noted.
Symptoms: burning epigastric pain; nocturnal acid regurgitation; dysphagia

Clinical_Note: 41-year-old female presenting with persistent low mood, anhedonia, insomnia, and difficulty concentrating for 3 months. PHQ-9 score of 18 indicates Severe Major Depressive Disorder. Started on Sertraline 50 mg once daily for 14 days, titrated to 100 mg once daily. Patient experienced transient Sertraline-induced insomnia and dry mouth during the first 5 days.
Symptoms: persistent low mood; anhedonia; insomnia; difficulty concentrating; dry mouth

Clinical_Note: 65-year-old male presenting with paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, orthopnea, and 3+ pitting pedal edema. Echocardiogram shows ejection fraction of 35% confirming Systolic Congestive Heart Failure. Prescribed Sacubitril-Valsartan 49/51 mg twice daily, Empagliflozin 10 mg once daily, and Spironolactone 25 mg once daily. Patient experienced mild asymptomatic hypotension on day 5 of therapy.
Symptoms: paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea; orthopnea; pitting pedal edema; hypotension
Frequency: twice daily; once daily; once daily

Clinical_Note: 50-year-old female presenting with fatigue, unexplained weight gain, cold intolerance, and constipation over the past 4 months. TSH level markedly elevated at 14.2 mIU/L with low free T4. Diagnosed with Primary Hypothyroidism (Hashimoto Thyroiditis). Initiated on Levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily in morning on empty stomach for ongoing treatment. Patient reports no adverse side effects.
Symptoms: fatigue; unexplained weight gain; cold intolerance; constipation

Clinical_Note: 60-year-old male presenting with progressive right knee pain, joint crepitus, and stiffness aggravated by weight bearing over 1 year. Radiographs demonstrate severe joint space narrowing confirming Osteoarthritis of Right Knee. Prescribed Celecoxib 200 mg once daily as needed for pain and Topical Diclofenac gel 1% 4 times daily for 30 days. Patient reports minor Celecoxib-induced dyspepsia after 2 weeks.
Symptoms: progressive right knee pain; joint crepitus; joint stiffness; dyspepsia
Frequency: once daily as needed; 4 times daily

Clinical_Note: 38-year-old female presenting with pruritic, well-demarcated erythematous plaques covered with silvery scales over bilateral knees and elbows for 5 months. Diagnosed with Plaque Psoriasis. Prescribed Clobetasol propionate ointment 0.05% twice daily for 14 days and Methotrexate 10 mg once weekly. Patient developed mild local skin atrophy after 10 days of topical steroid application.
Symptoms: erythematous plaques; silvery scales; pruritus; skin atrophy

Clinical_Note: 54-year-old male with chronic alcohol use presenting with right upper quadrant abdominal discomfort, jaundice, and fatigue for 3 weeks. Abdominal ultrasound reveals diffuse increased echogenicity consistent with Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) progressing to Hepatic Steatosis. Prescribed Vitamin E 800 IU once daily and Ursodeoxycholic Acid 300 mg twice daily for 90 days.
Symptoms: right upper quadrant discomfort; jaundice; fatigue

Clinical_Note: 48-year-old female undergoing adjuvant chemotherapy for Stage II Invasive Ductal Carcinoma of Left Breast. Patient complains of severe nausea, persistent vomiting, and generalized weakness following Cycle 2 Doxorubicin-Cyclophosphamide regimen 3 days ago. Prescribed Ondansetron 8 mg every 8 hours as needed and Dexamethasone 4 mg once daily for 5 days. Experienced Ondansetron-induced headache.
Symptoms: severe nausea; persistent vomiting; weakness; headache
